import datetime,json,os,pathlib,sqlite3,subprocess,tomllib
lab=pathlib.Path.home()/'.local/state/openshell-lab'
assert json.loads((lab/'artifact-capture.created').read_text())=={'project':'lab22','purpose':'disposable bounded artifact capture acceptance'}
settings=tomllib.loads((lab/'worker/worker.toml').read_text()); assert settings['max_artifact_size']==1048576
info=json.loads((lab/'evidence/artifact-capture.json').read_text())['environment']
assert (info['project_id'],info['environment_id'])==('lab22','lab22-capture')
env=dict(os.environ);env.update(settings['openshell']['env'])
guest='''import json,pathlib,stat,sys
root=pathlib.Path('/sandbox/project/sessions/capture'); helpers=[];unreadable=0
for entry in pathlib.Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not entry.name.isdigit():continue
 try:args=(entry/'cmdline').open('rb').read(65537).split(b'\\0')
 except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError):continue
 except PermissionError:unreadable+=1;continue
 if b'--helper' in args and any(pathlib.PurePosixPath(arg.decode(errors='replace')).name=='capture.py' for arg in args[:5]):helpers.append(int(entry.name))
files={}
for name in ['exact.bin','empty','regular-too-large','sparse-too-large','link.bin','pipe']:
 s=(root/name).lstat();files[name]={'size':s.st_size,'regular':stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode),'symlink':stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode),'fifo':stat.S_ISFIFO(s.st_mode)}
print(json.dumps({'python':sys.version,'boot_id':pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),'sources':files,'capture_helper_processes':helpers,'unreadable_cmdlines':unreadable}))
'''
p=subprocess.run([settings['openshell']['cli'],'sandbox','exec','-n',info['sandbox'],'--no-tty','--no-login-shell','--','/opt/sandbox-science/bin/python','-I','-S','-c',guest],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,check=True)
observed=json.loads(p.stdout); assert not observed['capture_helper_processes']; assert observed['unreadable_cmdlines']==0
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{lab}/worker/state/worker.sqlite3?mode=ro',uri=True);con.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
try:
 leases=[dict(r) for r in con.execute('SELECT publication_id,environment_id,incarnation,capture_id,phase,guest_clean,sandbox,sandbox_id FROM artifact_capture_leases LIMIT 5')]; assert not leases
 artifacts=[json.loads(r['record']) for r in con.execute('SELECT record FROM artifacts LIMIT 20')]; assert len(artifacts)==5
 tables=[r[0] for r in con.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")]
 executions=[{'execution_id':r['execution_id'],'environment_id':r['environment_id'],'terminal':r['terminal']} for r in con.execute('SELECT execution_id,environment_id,terminal FROM executions LIMIT 20')]; assert len(executions)==3 and all(r['terminal'] for r in executions)
finally:con.close()
record={'recorded_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(),'sandbox':info['sandbox'],'sandbox_id':info['sandbox_id'],'guest':observed,'capture_leases':leases,'artifacts':artifacts,'executions':executions}
(lab/'evidence/artifact-capture-state.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'guest':observed,'capture_leases':leases,'artifact_count':len(artifacts),'terminal_executions':len(executions)},indent=2))
